quote: Odin (Old Norse: Óðinn) is the main god in Norse mythology. Described as an immensely wise, one-eyed old man

statement.id: Odin adalah dewa utama mitologi Nordik yang digambarkan bijak dan bermata satu.
statement.en: Odin is a leading Norse god depicted as wise and one-eyed.

quote: the god of poetry, of the dead, of runes, and of magic.

statement.id: Odin terkait dengan puisi, orang mati, rune, dan sihir.
statement.en: Odin is associated with poetry, the dead, runes, and magic.

quote: Odin's two ravens, Huginn ('thought') and Muninn ('wisdom') are very old mythical elements

statement.id: Dua gagak Odin bernama Huginn dan Muninn.
statement.en: Odin's two ravens are Huginn and Muninn.

quote: In the mythic future, Odin leads the einherjar at Ragnarök, where he is killed by the monstrous wolf Fenrir.

statement.id: Dalam Ragnarök Odin dibunuh oleh Fenrir.
statement.en: Odin is killed by Fenrir at Ragnarök.

quote: From written sources such as Snorri's Edda, other Edda poems and the Icelandic sagas, which was written down in the Middle Ages, we know the stories of Odin, Thor and the other Norse gods.

statement.id: Kisah Odin antara lain dikenal dari Edda dan saga Islandia yang ditulis pada Abad Pertengahan.
statement.en: Odin's tales survive in Edda writings and Icelandic sagas recorded in the Middle Ages.

quote: gathers slain warriors around him in Valhalla ('hall of the slain')

statement.id: Odin mengumpulkan pejuang gugur di Valhalla.
statement.en: Odin gathers fallen warriors in Valhalla.

quote: They fly around the world gathering news, and when they return, they sit on Odin's shoulder and whisper their tidings into his ear.

statement.id: Huginn dan Muninn terbang mencari kabar bagi Odin.
statement.en: The ravens fly to gather news for Odin.

quote: Odin can be recognised by his hat and cloak, long beard, and only one eye

statement.id: Odin dikenali dari topi dan jubahnya, janggut panjang, dan hanya satu mata.
statement.en: Odin is recognised by his hat and cloak, long beard, and only one eye.

quote: His spear Gungnir is one of his main attributes

statement.id: Tombak Gungnir adalah salah satu atribut utama Odin.
statement.en: His spear Gungnir is one of his main attributes.

quote: Some other attributes are the ring Draupnir, which drips to form eight new rings every nine nights, and the horse Sleipnir, which is mentioned early on in Old Norse literature and is set apart by the somehow efficient total of eight legs.

statement.id: Atribut Odin lainnya adalah cincin Draupnir, yang meneteskan delapan cincin baru setiap sembilan malam, dan kuda Sleipnir yang berkaki delapan.
statement.en: Other attributes of Odin are the ring Draupnir, which drips eight new rings every nine nights, and the eight-legged horse Sleipnir.

quote: Odin's immense knowledge is courtesy of Mímir's head (or else due to drinking from Mímir's well).

statement.id: Pengetahuan Odin yang luas disebut berasal dari kepala Mímir, atau dari minum air sumur Mímir.
statement.en: Odin's immense knowledge is said to come from Mímir's head, or else from drinking from Mímir's well.

quote: The owner of the well hight Mimer. He is full of wisdom, for he drinks from the well with the Gjallar-horn. Alfather once came there and asked for a drink from the well, but he did not get it before he left one of his eyes as a pledge.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, Alfather tidak mendapat minum dari sumur Mimer sebelum meninggalkan salah satu matanya sebagai jaminan.
statement.en: According to the Prose Edda, Alfather received a drink from Mimer's well only after leaving one of his eyes there as a pledge.

quote: nine nights of swinging from a branch of Yggdrasil, the World Tree, with a spear wound that put him close to death, and only then are the runes revealed to him.

statement.id: Odin menggantung sembilan malam di dahan Yggdrasil, pohon dunia, dengan luka tombak yang nyaris membunuhnya, dan baru setelah itu rune terungkap kepadanya.
statement.en: Odin hangs for nine nights from a branch of Yggdrasil, the World Tree, with a spear wound that brings him close to death, and only then are the runes revealed to him.

quote: Snorri explains that Odin's superb poetic skills are due to him stealing the mead of the skalds (i.e. poets) by sleeping with the giantess Gunnlǫð, guardian of the mead, for three nights.

statement.id: Snorri menjelaskan bahwa kemahiran puisi Odin berasal dari pencurian mead para skald (penyair) setelah ia tidur tiga malam dengan raksasa perempuan Gunnlǫð, penjaga mead itu.
statement.en: Snorri explains that Odin's poetic skill comes from stealing the mead of the skalds (poets) after sleeping for three nights with the giantess Gunnlǫð, the mead's guardian.

quote: his son Borr and the giant-daughter Bestla sired Odin and his brothers (usually named Vili and Vé)

statement.id: Borr dan raksasa perempuan Bestla menjadi orang tua Odin dan saudara-saudaranya, yang biasanya bernama Vili dan Vé.
statement.en: Borr and the giantess Bestla sired Odin and his brothers, usually named Vili and Vé.

quote: The brothers then slew the proto-giant Ymir and used his flesh to create the earth, his skull to form the sky, his bones for the mountains, and his blood to make the sea.

statement.id: Odin bersaudara membunuh raksasa purba Ymir dan memakai dagingnya untuk bumi, tengkoraknya untuk langit, tulangnya untuk gunung, dan darahnya untuk laut.
statement.en: Odin and his brothers slew the proto-giant Ymir and made the earth from his flesh, the sky from his skull, the mountains from his bones, and the sea from his blood.

quote: Odin's connection with war flows naturally into a connection with the dead, which is further illustrated by Odin as the leader of the so-called Wild Hunt - a widespread and old Germanic cult centred around a myth of an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

statement.id: Hubungan Odin dengan perang berlanjut ke hubungannya dengan orang mati, antara lain sebagai pemimpin Perburuan Liar (Wild Hunt), pasukan orang mati yang menunggang badai.
statement.en: Odin's link with war extends to a link with the dead, shown in his role as leader of the Wild Hunt, an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

quote: Odin has his Valkyries - supernatural warrior women - bringing the bodies of fighters slain in battle to his special warrior paradise Valhalla; these fighters are known as the Einherjar and become Odin's strike-force against the encroaching powers of the Underworld during the Ragnarök.

statement.id: Para Valkyrie, perempuan prajurit gaib, membawa jasad prajurit yang gugur ke Valhalla; mereka dikenal sebagai Einherjar dan menjadi pasukan Odin melawan kekuatan dunia bawah saat Ragnarök.
statement.en: Odin's Valkyries, supernatural warrior women, bring fighters slain in battle to Valhalla; these fighters, the Einherjar, become Odin's strike-force against the powers of the Underworld at Ragnarök.

quote: In southern and western Germanic sources, it was Odin who decided whether battles or individual warriors would be victorious or end in slightly less fortunate ways.

statement.id: Dalam sumber Jermanik selatan dan barat, Odin yang menentukan kemenangan pertempuran atau prajurit tertentu.
statement.en: In southern and western Germanic sources, Odin decided whether battles or individual warriors would be victorious.

quote: He [Odin] is described as falling into trances, as leaving his body behind and travelling abroad in the spirit-form of an animal, and several times as having visions of wisdom provoked by various kinds of ordeal.

statement.id: Odin digambarkan jatuh ke dalam trans, meninggalkan tubuhnya dan mengembara dalam wujud roh hewan, serta beberapa kali mendapat penglihatan kebijaksanaan lewat berbagai cobaan.
statement.en: Odin is described as falling into trances, leaving his body to travel in the spirit-form of an animal, and several times having visions of wisdom provoked by ordeals.

quote: in the great pagan temple of Old Uppsala in Sweden, too; in 1070 CE Adam of Bremen wrote of his visit to this place that a statue of Thor stood prominently in the centre of the hall, with Odin and Freyr to the side, and that sacrifices were made to Thor in case of famine, to Odin in times of war

statement.id: Pada 1070 M, Adam dari Bremen menulis bahwa di kuil Uppsala kuno patung Thor berdiri di tengah, Odin dan Freyr di sisinya, dan persembahan untuk Odin dibuat pada masa perang.
statement.en: In 1070 CE Adam of Bremen wrote that at the Old Uppsala temple a statue of Thor stood in the centre with Odin and Freyr at the sides, and that sacrifices were made to Odin in times of war.

quote: Several of these stem from the reconstructed Proto-Germanic theonym Wōðanaz, meaning "lord of frenzy" or "leader of the possessed"

statement.id: Beberapa nama dan gelar Odin berasal dari nama dewa Proto-Jermanik hasil rekonstruksi, Wōðanaz, yang berarti "penguasa kegilaan" atau "pemimpin orang yang kerasukan".
statement.en: Several of Odin's names and titles stem from the reconstructed Proto-Germanic theonym Wōðanaz, meaning "lord of frenzy" or "leader of the possessed".

quote: He also exists in Germanic mythology as Woden (in Old English), Wodan (in Old Franconian), and Wutan or Wuotan (in Old High German).

statement.id: Odin juga dikenal dalam mitologi Jermanik sebagai Woden (Inggris Kuno), Wodan (Franka Kuno), serta Wutan atau Wuotan (Jerman Kuno Tinggi).
statement.en: Odin also exists in Germanic mythology as Woden (Old English), Wodan (Old Franconian), and Wutan or Wuotan (Old High German).

quote: Alfather he is called in our tongue, but in Asgard of old he had twelve names.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, sang dewa tertinggi disebut Alfather, dan di Asgard lama ia memiliki dua belas nama.
statement.en: According to the Prose Edda, the highest god is called Alfather, and in old Asgard he had twelve names.

quote: Odin rides first; with his golden helmet, resplendent byrnie, and his spear Gungner, he advances against the Fenris-wolf.

statement.id: Dalam Edda Prosa, Odin maju paling depan dengan helm emas, baju zirah gemerlap, dan tombak Gungner melawan serigala Fenris.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Odin rides first, with golden helmet, resplendent byrnie, and his spear Gungner, and advances against the Fenris-wolf.

quote: He was also adapted in Neil Gaiman's 2001 novel American Gods as Mr. Wednesday, a con artist revealed to be an incarnation of Odin.

statement.id: Odin diadaptasi dalam novel American Gods karya Neil Gaiman (2001) sebagai Mr. Wednesday, penipu yang ternyata adalah inkarnasi Odin.
statement.en: Odin was adapted in Neil Gaiman's 2001 novel American Gods as Mr. Wednesday, a con artist revealed to be an incarnation of Odin.

quote: Odin was adapted as a character by Marvel Comics, first appearing in the Journey into Mystery series in 1962.

statement.id: Odin diadaptasi sebagai tokoh oleh Marvel Comics dan pertama muncul dalam seri Journey into Mystery pada 1962.
statement.en: Odin was adapted as a character by Marvel Comics, first appearing in the Journey into Mystery series in 1962.

quote: The nature of Odin's magic moreover often causes him to be seen as a shaman, an aspect which is further bolstered by his function as a god of healing.

statement.id: Sihir Odin membuatnya sering dipandang sebagai syaman, dan pandangan ini diperkuat oleh fungsinya sebagai dewa penyembuhan.
statement.en: The nature of Odin's magic often leads him to be seen as a shaman, an aspect reinforced by his function as a god of healing.

quote: Wider sources depict Odin as the son of Bestla and Borr; brother to Vili and Vé; and husband to the goddess Frigg, with whom he fathered Baldr. Odin has many other sons, including Thor, whom he sired with the earth-goddess Jörð.

statement.id: Sumber yang lebih luas menggambarkan Odin sebagai putra Bestla dan Borr, saudara Vili dan Vé, serta suami dewi Frigg, yang melahirkan Baldr; ia juga ayah Thor dari dewi bumi Jörð.
statement.en: Wider sources depict Odin as son of Bestla and Borr, brother of Vili and Vé, and husband of the goddess Frigg, with whom he fathered Baldr; he also fathered Thor with the earth-goddess Jörð.

quote: Odin's role of 'Allfather' or father of the gods is more of a literary theme from later sources - seemingly influenced by Christian names for God - than an actual reflection of his status in Viking Age societies.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, peran Odin sebagai Allfather lebih merupakan tema sastra dari sumber yang lebih muda, tampaknya dipengaruhi sebutan Kristen untuk Tuhan, ketimbang cerminan kedudukannya di masyarakat Zaman Viking.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Odin's role as Allfather is more a literary theme from later sources, seemingly influenced by Christian names for God, than a reflection of his status in Viking Age societies.

quote: And for this reason Odin is called Alfather, that he is the father of all gods and men, and of all things that were made by him and by his might.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, Odin disebut Alfather karena ia bapak semua dewa dan manusia serta segala yang dibuat olehnya.
statement.en: According to the Prose Edda, Odin is called Alfather because he is the father of all gods and men and of all things made by him and his might.

quote: Odin used mainly magic to catch glimpses of the future.

statement.id: Odin terutama memakai sihir untuk melihat sekilas masa depan.
statement.en: Odin mainly used magic to catch glimpses of the future.

quote: Because of this cosying up to her, he is allowed three sips, but he simply chugs and drains the containers, shape-shifts into an eagle and legs it (well, wings it) out of there.

statement.id: Dalam kisah mead puisi, Odin diizinkan tiga tegukan tetapi menghabiskan seluruh wadahnya, lalu berubah wujud menjadi elang dan kabur.
statement.en: In the story of the mead of poetry, Odin is allowed three sips but drains the containers, shape-shifts into an eagle and flees.

quote: resides in Asgard (the stronghold and home of the gods)

statement.id: Odin tinggal di Asgard, benteng dan kediaman para dewa.
statement.en: Odin resides in Asgard, the stronghold and home of the gods.

quote: Already in the Bronze Age do Swedish rock carvings depict figures of a god holding a spear, who with some imagination might be linked to Odin, and by at least 500 CE he clearly shows up on a range of ornaments alongside birds and warriors.

statement.id: Ukiran batu Swedia dari Zaman Perunggu menampilkan sosok dewa bertombak yang mungkin dikaitkan dengan Odin, dan paling lambat sekitar 500 M ia jelas muncul pada berbagai hiasan bersama burung dan prajurit.
statement.en: Bronze Age Swedish rock carvings show figures of a god holding a spear who might be linked to Odin, and by at least 500 CE he clearly appears on ornaments alongside birds and warriors.

quote: Odin's main group of worshippers mostly consisted of the elite - kings, chieftains & poets - but also included warriors.

statement.id: Para pemuja utama Odin sebagian besar adalah kalangan elite, yaitu raja, kepala suku, dan penyair, serta juga prajurit.
statement.en: Odin's main group of worshippers mostly consisted of the elite, namely kings, chieftains and poets, but also included warriors.

quote: Skaldic poetry (Viking Age, pre-Christian poetry mainly heard at courts by kings and their retinues), for instance, names Baldr, Thor, and Vali as Odin's sons, whereas later on the 13th-century CE Icelandic author Snorri Sturluson also adds Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr, and Hodr to the list.

statement.id: Puisi skaldik menyebut Baldr, Thor, dan Vali sebagai putra Odin, sedangkan Snorri Sturluson pada abad ke-13 M menambahkan Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr, dan Hodr.
statement.en: Skaldic poetry names Baldr, Thor and Vali as Odin's sons, whereas the 13th-century CE author Snorri Sturluson adds Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr and Hodr.

quote: in the Vafþrúðnismál Odin initiates a battle of wits with the giant Vafþrúðnir and beats him, while in the Grímnismál a disguised Odin is tortured and ends up revealing his extensive mythical knowledge to King Geirroðr.

statement.id: Dalam Vafþrúðnismál Odin memulai adu kecerdasan dengan raksasa Vafþrúðnir dan mengalahkannya; dalam Grímnismál Odin yang menyamar disiksa dan akhirnya membuka pengetahuannya kepada Raja Geirroðr.
statement.en: In Vafþrúðnismál Odin starts a battle of wits with the giant Vafþrúðnir and beats him; in Grímnismál a disguised Odin is tortured and ends up revealing his mythical knowledge to King Geirroðr.

quote: The modern English weekday name Wednesday traces its origins to "day of Woden", wōdnesdæg in Old English, and is still seen in the Dutch name woensdag.

statement.id: Nama hari Wednesday dalam bahasa Inggris modern berasal dari "hari Woden" (wōdnesdæg dalam bahasa Inggris Kuno), dan masih terlihat pada nama Belanda woensdag.
statement.en: The modern English weekday name Wednesday traces its origin to "day of Woden" (wōdnesdæg in Old English), still seen in the Dutch name woensdag.
